name: New Geyskit Restaurant
why_it_matters: The Padum stop most travel guides single out for actual Zanskari cooking — shabalay (a meat-and-vegetable stuffed fried bread) is what regulars come for. Walking distance from the post office on the main market road; doubles as a meeting point for trek guides, foreign trekkers, and local schoolchildren.
insider_tip: Order shabalay first — it sells out by mid-afternoon. Pair it with butter tea, not chai; the kitchen leans Zanskari.
signature_address: Main Market Road, opposite Padum Post Office, Padum 194302

name: Hotel Ibex Restaurant
why_it_matters: A budget Padum institution organised around a sunny grass courtyard isolated from the dusty street — the rare Padum dining room with garden seating. Trekker hub from the moment Pensi La opens; closed November-end-May with the road.
insider_tip: Eat in the courtyard, not the dim indoor dining room. Food quality is hit-or-miss — stick to the simple thukpa and momos rather than ambitious continental orders.
signature_address: Main Market, Padum 194302, Kargil District, Ladakh

name: Dee Grand Marq Hotel Restaurant
why_it_matters: The most polished sit-down dining room in Padum — generally singled out by TripAdvisor reviewers as the closest the town has to a hotel-grade kitchen. Mixed local-and-continental menu; one of the few places that lists a sizzler.
insider_tip: Non-veg isn't served on Mondays — call ahead if mutton or chicken is your plan. Mutton runs ₹350 for two pieces; portions are honest, not generous.
signature_address: Padum Town, Zanskar Valley, Kargil District, Ladakh 194302

name: Mont-Blanc Guest House Kitchen
why_it_matters: A four-room family guesthouse 800m south of Padum's main market, 200m before the mosque — Lonely Planet's long-running Padum recommendation. Garden seating and a rooftop view the bigger hotels in town don't match.
insider_tip: Not a walk-in restaurant — eat here only if you're staying or have phoned ahead (01983 245183). Ask the family to cook skyu the night before; it isn't on a printed menu.
signature_address: 800m south of Main Market, Padum 194302, Kargil District, Ladakh

name: Hotel Potala Zanskar Restaurant
why_it_matters: A heated dining room — rare in Padum, where most kitchens shut from October. The Maneyringmo branch markets itself as the first centrally-heated property in Padum, which makes shoulder-season meals here viable.
insider_tip: Eat lunch indoors at the centre table by the window — the heating works, the kitchen's organic-ingredient claim is most credible at midday. Call +91-7018886133 to confirm before walking over in shoulder season.
signature_address: Maneyringmo P.O., Padum, Zanskar, Kargil District, Ladakh 194302

name: Zanskar Eco Lodge Dining Room
why_it_matters: Family-run dining room in the centre of Karsha village, a 10km drive across the Stod from Padum and walking distance from Karsha Monastery. Mr Tashi and his wife cook every meal — closest most travellers get to a real Zanskari home kitchen without a homestay introduction.
insider_tip: Phone the lodge a day ahead from Padum so they can plan portions — they're a small family, not a restaurant. Pair the meal with the morning Karsha Gompa walk; the lodge sits on the river path up to the monastery.
signature_address: Karsha Village, near Karsha Monastery, Zanskar, Kargil District, Ladakh 194302
